basics.name: Runguo Li
basics.summary: M.S. student in Information Management at UIUC, working on ML systems for large-scale models: MoE inference engines and expert streaming, KV-cache compression, distributed training and rollout infrastructure, and GPU compiler and kernel-level correctness. 22 merged pull requests across 14 upstream projects, including PyTorch, vLLM, DeepSpeed, LLVM, SGLang, JAX, FlashAttention, Triton, and Megatron-LM. Applying to Ph.D. programs in ML systems for Fall 2028.

education.institution: Shanghai University of Finance and Economics

publications.name: AXR: Reusing Intermediate Results for LLM Agents in PostgreSQL
publications.summary: A PostgreSQL extension that materializes plan-subtree results as LLM agents query and reuses them in later plans; 6.5–51.0% less database time on TPC-H with no wrong result in 776,114 checked executions.

publications.name: How Much Does Random Rotation Help GPTQ? Sharp Worst-Case Rate Gaps in the High-Rate Regime
publications.summary: Sharp worst-case rate gap between randomly rotated GPTQ and WaterSIC via the Lyapunov-exponent limit of Cholesky pivots; median gap 0.04 bit on 96 Qwen3 and Llama-3.1 Hessians.

publications.name: Certified Sparse Attention via Perturbed Retrieval
publications.summary: Sparse attention with per-head error certificates via perturbed retrieval; no certificate violated on three LLMs at 16K–128K tokens, with 4.6–7.9× lower 90th-percentile error than the best of 15 baseline families at equal keys read.

publications.name: Spend Bytes on Breadth: Precision–Count Trade-offs for Decode-Time KV Compression in Long Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
publications.summary: BreadthKV splits a fixed decode-time KV byte budget between token count and precision, beating eviction alone in 17 of 18 settings.
